evidence.observation: Exhaust O2 climbs monotonically from ~6 ppm to 51.5 ppm through growth, far above purge-established baseline
Tube pressure rises steadily 2.98 -> 3.44 Torr while Ar setpoint/flow held constant at 100 sccm
MFC reading stable at ~100 sccm, so pressure rise is not from increased Ar delivery
Temperature control normal at 750 °C, heater power steady ~43%, so pressure rise is not thermal

args.missing_evidence: A flow-off / pump-down leak-rate check (isolate Ar and watch dP/dt and O2) would confirm air ingress versus an exhaust/pumping change; a downstream O2 sensor cross-check would rule out sensor drift.
